'''Andrew Mahjowald''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 St. Cloud tournament]] on 18 November 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|RalOps]], according to Joshua Grace's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1482">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-21-wheres-my-monnok-the-full-report-mixd1482/ wheres-my-monnok-the-full-report-mix], DeckTech (Joshua "Stormcrow" Grace, 21 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-21-wheres-my-monnok-the-full-report-mixd1482/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
